filter_note: V1 set (7) + market briefing + AI news; Today window = Tue Oct 20 – Wed Oct 21 PT

market_briefing.lede: The fight over AI agents is moving from what they can do to what it costs and who controls them inside the systems they touch. Salesforce is negotiating with partners over its plan to bill every agent call into the CRM, while ServiceNow shipped a personal enterprise agent whose actions are governed by IT policy and enforced in the runtime.

bullets.text: Metering agent access to the CRM meets pushback: Salesforce plans to charge Flex Credits for every successful MCP or API call made by a registered agent (a "Headless Platform Interaction"; rate still TBA, 30 days' notice before billing). On Oct 21 Salesforce Ben reported that senior Salesforce stakeholders opened talks with partners after a backlash; the asks are more predictable agent pricing, value beyond plain MCP access, and room for AI-assisted org setup and support. No change has been announced.

Agent governance moves into the runtime: ServiceNow made Arc GA on Oct 21, a personal long-running agent across ServiceNow, email and Teams that can build its own integrations, with actions governed by IT policy and enforced in NVIDIA OpenShell. It is included at no extra cost in Foundation, Advanced and Prime SKUs. AI Passport revocation in software and silicon comes in a future release.

AI that runs whole GTM programs, not single tasks, is getting funded: Different came out of stealth on Oct 20 with a $48M seed led by General Catalyst. It plans, launches and optimizes B2B demand-gen campaigns across ads, email, landing pages and answer-engine content, with marketers approving everything before it goes live. Customer results are company claims.

biggest_ai_news.title: OpenAI models and Codex are coming to Google Cloud
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 21: OpenAI frontier models and Codex agentic workflows will be in Google Cloud's Model Garden, bought through Google Cloud Marketplace, and can draw down existing GCP spend commitments. OpenAI models will also come to Google Antigravity and the Gemini Agent. GA is planned in the coming weeks; Microsoft remains OpenAI's primary cloud partner.

biggest_ai_news.title: Anthropic could file its public S-1 as soon as Friday
biggest_ai_news.body: Yahoo Finance (Oct 21, three sources): a public filing would clear the way for a possible November listing. The WSJ reported (Oct 20) that a draft prospectus shows $16.3B revenue and a net loss of more than $80B in H1 2026, driven by $72B in accounting charges on convertible notes and other instruments. Reuters says some investors are discussing a valuation near $1.5T, down from about $2T expected. Anthropic did not comment.

biggest_ai_news.title: NVIDIA launches the OpenShell Reference Architecture for governed agents
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 21 (GTC Berlin): a full-stack design for building, containing, observing and enforcing agents, with OpenShell runtime on Vera CPUs, inference on Vera Rubin, and BlueField-4 DPUs running NVIDIA Sentry to quarantine agents that leave their boundary. Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Meta, Microsoft, SAP and ServiceNow are among those working with it. Available now.

what_changed.title: Salesforce opens talks with partners over agent billing
what_changed.body: NEW (watchlist, third-party report). Oct 21: after public partner pushback on charging Flex Credits for agentic MCP and API calls, Salesforce reached out to Salesforce architect and ISV/SI owner Amnon Kruvi; he says the call was with senior stakeholders and the discussions continue. The rate per call is still TBA and nothing is metered yet.

what_changed.title: ServiceNow Arc goes GA, governed through NVIDIA OpenShell
what_changed.body: NEW (category). Oct 21: a personal, long-running enterprise agent that surfaces work from inbox, meetings and backlog, runs tasks for minutes or days, and is restricted at runtime by policies set in ServiceNow's Super Intelligence Control Tower. Mac now, Windows within weeks.

what_changed.title: Different launches with a $48M seed for AI-run demand gen
what_changed.body: NEW (category). Oct 20: founded by ThoughtSpot and Nutanix co-founder Ajeet Singh; General Catalyst led, Lightspeed participated. Pitch: a marketing team of five does the work of 50. Available now.

what_changed.title: Salesforce named a Leader in the first IDC MarketScape for agentic AI platforms
what_changed.body: NEW (watchlist, soft). Oct 21: IDC evaluated 25 vendors. Salesforce cites the strengths IDC named: distribution scale, hybrid reasoning with deterministic control (Atlas plus Agent Script), and a native data foundation. This is an analyst ranking, not a product change.

quiet_note: No first-party news Oct 20–21 from Gong (Gartner MQ Oct 16 still top of press), Clay (X posts not brief-worthy), Outreach, Nooks, Salesloft (Oct 6 still top) or Monaco. Agent Optimizer / AI Skills October GA still not confirmed by Salesforce. Aged off Today: Salesforce–Braze, Notion AI credits, Vendavo Deal Desk, Lawpath Agentforce SDR (covered Oct 20).

watch.title: Salesforce's per-call rate for agent access
watch.body: Salesforce has not published the Flex Credit multiplier for Headless Platform Interactions. Watch for that number, the 30-day notice that starts billing, and whether partner talks change the model, for example a predictable bundle or an exemption for AI-assisted setup. Any agent that calls Salesforce over MCP or API would need to register under Agentic Identity and move to the new billing. Also open: Agent Optimizer / AI Skills October GA, with 10 days left.

interpretation.fact: Salesforce Ben reported Salesforce opened talks with partners over agentic MCP/API billing (Oct 21). ServiceNow made Arc GA, governed via NVIDIA OpenShell (Oct 21). NVIDIA launched the OpenShell Reference Architecture (Oct 21). Different raised a $48M seed (Oct 20). Salesforce was named a Leader in IDC's first agentic AI platforms MarketScape (Oct 21). OpenAI models and Codex are coming to Google Cloud (Oct 21). Anthropic may file its public S-1 as soon as Friday (Yahoo Finance, Oct 21).
interpretation.note: Light interpretation: the systems of record are setting prices for agent access just as third-party agents multiply. How Salesforce prices and enforces Agentic Identity will shape the cost of any agent that works on top of the CRM. Governance is shifting from dashboards to enforcement points (runtime, identity, hardware) that buyers can name in a procurement checklist.

feed.summary: Co-founder says Monaco's re-engagement agent, part of Agent Matrix, is getting 25–35% response rates reviving leads that went cold.
Nooks says TechCrunch named it one of the top 5 sales tools revenue teams are adopting in 2026; cites a 24% per-rep pipeline lift at HubSpot.
Monaco launched Agent Matrix, multiple goal-seeking agents working together on revenue growth; early access is by application.
Salesforce added a Donor Engagement Agent in Winter '27 that turns voice memos, photos or notes into donor-record updates and next steps.
Gong is promoting its second straight Leader placement in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Revenue Action Orchestration.
Winter '27 lets admins keep manual record shares through ownership changes and use custom row causes on standard objects.
Salesforce signed a definitive agreement to acquire Braze, the customer engagement platform, to complement Data 360, Customer 360, Agentforce and SIforce.
